items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [saying to Ken Kimery] See? I got to show him something about his book.

ctx.x: Well you nailed it and that’s hard to do. At that point very few people were playing above the standard range of the alto, right?
Thank you very much. [saying to Kimery about Kirchner] See how kind he is?
